paragraphs: Welcome to the tastiest grill site — our dishes are made only from fresh local meat, and skilled couriers deliver them hot and fast.
Grill.am is one of the longest-running food chains on the Armenian market, preparing meals with the most delicious, high-quality meat products.
Since 2013-05-20 we have been operating under the grill.am brand, which is also our website address.
We promise: the fastest and tastiest dishes are waiting for you on our menu.

We are at 9 locations — Khorenatsi 95/2, Khorenatsi 88, Pushkin 43/3, Totovents 2/7, Baghramyan 50/5, Admiral Isakov 27, Andranik 94/4, Sebastia 16/1, Tigran Petrosyan 13/8 — and we also offer fast, delicious delivery.
